description_en: Adds IP addresses to an egress proxy IP address pool
description_zh: 向出口代理地址池添加IP地址
name: AddIpAddressesToEgressProxyIpPool

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the value, but you must ensure that it is unique among different requests. The client token can contain only ASCII characters.

Note If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId of each API request is unique
parameters.help_zh:
客户端 Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一。ClientToken 只支持 ASCII 字符。

说明 若您未指定，则系统自动使用 API 请求的 RequestId 作为 ClientToken 标识。每次 API 请求的 RequestId 不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform only a dry run. Valid values:

true: performs a dry run and does not add IP addresses to the egress proxy IP address pool. The system checks whether the required parameters are specified, the request format is valid, and the service limits are met. If the request fails the dry run, an error message is returned. If the request passes the dry run, the DryRunOperation error code is returned.
false (default): performs a dry run and sends the actual request. If the request passes the dry run, an HTTP 2xx status code is returned and the operation is performed
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求，取值：

true：发送检查请求，不会向出口地址池增加地址。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码 DryRunOperation。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回 HTTP 2xx 状态码并直接进行操作
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en: The ID of the egress proxy IP address pool to which you want to add IP addresses
parameters.help_zh: 待添加 IP 地址的出口代理地址池 ID
parameters.name: egress_proxy_ip_pool_id

fields.help_en: The ID of the elastic IP address (EIP) instance. Specify this parameter only when the address type (AddressType) of the IP address pool is Internet
fields.help_zh: 弹性公网 IP（EIP）实例 ID。仅当地址池的地址类型（AddressType）为 Internet 时填写
fields.name: eip_allocation_id

fields.help_en: The private IPv4 address. The address must be an active address in the corresponding vSwitch CIDR block. Specify this parameter only when the address type (AddressType) of the IP address pool is Intranet
fields.help_zh: 私网 IPv4 地址。需为对应交换机网段内的可用地址，仅当地址池的地址类型（AddressType）为 Intranet 时填写
fields.name: private_ipv4_address

fields.help_en: The list of IP addresses to be added
fields.help_zh: 待添加的 IP 地址列表
fields.name: ip_addresses

fields.help_en:
The number of private IPv4 addresses to be automatically allocated. This parameter takes effect only when the address type (AddressType) of the IP address pool is Intranet. The system automatically allocates the specified number of private IPv4 addresses in the vSwitch that corresponds to the active zone.

Note For each zone mapping of a private IP address pool, you must specify at least one of PrivateIpv4Address in IpAddresses and IpCount. If you specify both PrivateIpv4Address in IpAddresses and IpCount, the number of specified PrivateIpv4Address values cannot exceed the value of IpCount
fields.help_zh:
自动分配的私网 IPv4 地址数量。仅当地址池的地址类型（AddressType）为 Intranet 时生效，系统会在该可用区对应的交换机内自动分配相应数量的私网 IPv4 地址。

说明 私网地址池的每个可用区映射需至少指定 IpAddresses 中的 PrivateIpv4Address 或 IpCount 其一。若同时指定 IpAddresses 中的 PrivateIpv4Address 与 IpCount，则指定的 PrivateIpv4Address 数量不能超过 IpCount
fields.name: ip_count

fields.help_en: The zone ID. The zone must be an existing zone of the egress proxy IP address pool
fields.help_zh: 可用区 ID。需为该出口代理地址池已有的可用区
fields.name: zone_id

parameters.help_en: The zone mappings, which are used to specify the zones in which you want to add IP addresses and the IP addresses to be added. The zones must be existing zones of the egress proxy IP address pool
parameters.help_zh: 可用区映射列表，用于指定要在哪些可用区添加 IP 地址以及待添加的地址。可用区需为该出口代理地址池已有的可用区
parameters.name: zone_mappings
